description: Figure: acn1 deletion phenotype profile and its similarity to other S. pombe MBOAT deletions
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p=pd.read_csv("https://www.pombase.org/data/annotations/Phenotype_annotations/phenotype_annotations.pombase.phaf.gz",
              sep="\t",header=0,compression="gzip",dtype=str,low_memory=False)
sp=p[p['Gene systematic ID']=="SPBC3H7.05c"]
lab={"FYPO:0001406":"increased septum thickness","FYPO:0003166":"monoseptate, binucleate+anucleate compartments",
"FYPO:0000118":"multiseptate vegetative cell","FYPO:0009091":"decreased growth, lysine/proline N source",
"FYPO:0009076":"increased growth, sucrose C source","FYPO:0010042":"normal growth on pentadecanoic acid",
"FYPO:0002693":"resistance to diamide","FYPO:0009038":"resistance to egtazic acid","FYPO:0009039":"resistance to KCl",
"FYPO:0009081":"resistance to KCl + MMS","FYPO:0009043":"resistance to KCl + SDS","FYPO:0002767":"resistance to terbinafine",
"FYPO:0003383":"resistance to tert-butyl hydroperoxide","FYPO:0007921":"sensitive to benzamidine",
"FYPO:0001501":"sensitive to brefeldin A","FYPO:0000096":"sensitive to cadmium","FYPO:0009069":"sensitive to ciclopirox olamine",
"FYPO:0009086":"sensitive to LiCl + SDS","FYPO:0000111":"sensitive to rapamycin","FYPO:0002701":"sensitive to torin1",
"FYPO:0001457":"sensitive to tunicamycin","FYPO:0003656":"sensitive to vanadate","FYPO:0009063":"sensitive to X-rays",
"FYPO:0002060":"viable vegetative cell population","FYPO:0002177":"viable, normal cell morphology"}
dele=sp[sp['Allele description']=="deletion"]
terms=sorted(set(dele['FYPO ID']), key=lambda t: lab[t])
def cls(t):
    s=lab[t]
    return "resistant" if s.startswith("resist") else ("sensitive" if s.startswith("sensit") else "other")
col={"resistant":"#2a7fb8","sensitive":"#c0392b","other":"#7f8c8d"}

scr=p[(p['Reference']=="PMID:37787768")&(p['Allele description']=="deletion")]
bygene=scr.groupby('Gene systematic ID')['FYPO ID'].apply(set)
A=set(scr[scr['Gene systematic ID']=="SPBC3H7.05c"]['FYPO ID'])
jac=pd.Series({g:len(A&s)/len(A|s) for g,s in bygene.items() if g!="SPBC3H7.05c" and len(s)>=5})
mb={"ale1":"SPBC16A3.10","dga1":"SPCC1235.15","slc1":"SPAC1851.02","vps66":"SPAC1783.02c"}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,7.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.15,1]})
y=np.arange(len(terms))
ax[0].barh(y,[1]*len(terms),color=[col[cls(t)] for t in terms],height=.62)
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels([lab[t] for t in terms],fontsize=9)
ax[0].invert_yaxis(); ax[0].set_xticks([]); ax[0].set_xlim(0,1.02)
for sp_ in ['top','right','bottom']: ax[0].spines[sp_].set_visible(False)
ax[0].set_title("A. acn1delta phenotypes curated in PomBase (n=%d terms)"%len(terms),fontsize=11,loc='left')
hs=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=col[k]) for k in ["sensitive","resistant","other"]]
ax[0].legend(hs,["sensitive to","resistant to","growth / viability"],loc='lower right',fontsize=9,frameon=False)

ax[1].hist(jac.values,bins=40,color="#bdc3c7",edgecolor="white")
ax[1].axvline(jac.median(),color='k',ls='--',lw=1,label=f"background median J={jac.median():.3f}")
ax[1].axvline(jac.quantile(.95),color='k',ls=':',lw=1,label=f"background 95th pct={jac.quantile(.95):.3f}")
for i,(nmz,gid) in enumerate(mb.items()):
    v=jac.get(gid,np.nan)
    ax[1].annotate(nmz,xy=(v,0),xytext=(v,60+55*i),ha='center',fontsize=10,color="#c0392b",
                   arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b",lw=1.2))
ax[1].set_xlabel("Jaccard similarity of deletion phenotype profile to acn1delta",fontsize=10)
ax[1].set_ylabel("number of genes",fontsize=10)
ax[1].set_title("B. acn1delta vs 3,320 deletions in one screen (PMID 37787768)",fontsize=11,loc='left')
ax[1].legend(fontsize=9,frameon=False)
for sp_ in ['top','right']: ax[1].spines[sp_].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
